text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm, something's off... Maybe her nose
needs to be positioned
higher...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Mejiro Dober sitting in a corner in
the academy library. She wears a
concentrated look on her face, and she
seems to be drawing
something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No good. I should probably go back to the
outline.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's erase this... Oh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her arm slips as she applies vigorous
force toward erasing the
contents of the page,
and she knocks some stationery supplies
onto the ground.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh sheesh, now I've done it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I lean down and pick up the notebook that
had slipped onto the
floor. It's open to a
page with an illustration of an anime
character.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the main heroine of the long-running kids' anime Veggie Caroline. The notebook seems to be filled with similar such practice illustrations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Thanks...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Thank you for the help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Don't you dare look!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh... D-did you see that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make the excuse that it was simply
due to
the page being open to
that spot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make the excuse that it was simply
due to
the page being open to
that spot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You must think it looks pretty awful,
don't
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know... It doesn't look anything
like her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The character's eyes overflow with a
sparkly confidence—hope for the
future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The character's eyes overflow with a
sparkly confidence—hope for the
future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression looks kind, and I tell her
that Caroline has the kind of
stylish
eyelashes you don't normally see on an
anime character.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You aren't... making fun of me, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you don't have to go that far. I'm
glad that you like my
drawing, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I tend to draw in more of a shojo manga
style... I'm well aware that it
doesn't really
resemble her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I tend to draw in more of a shojo manga
style. It's kind of a habit at
this point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh come on, knock it off already!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh come on, you're embarrassing me!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Please lower your voice in the
library.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Please lower your voice in the
library.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
See? We got yelled at. Come on, Trainer.
It's almost time for today's
session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we walk over toward the training staff
room, I decide to ask her a
question out of
curiosity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I mean... I watched it when I was a kid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't go that far...
I just watched it a
lot as a kid. You recognized
the character,
so I'm guessing it's the same for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's just a coincidence. I simply like to
draw.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's just a way to pass the time.
I do love
drawing quite a lot, but the
characters are
just coincidental.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I could draw characters from many other
anime if I wanted to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I happened to catch it on TV recently, so
the urge to draw them kind
of just struck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she says this, I can't help but
recall the face that she was
making while
she was drawing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she says this, I can't help but
recall the face that she was
making while
she was drawing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At first I thought that it was something
that she had to do, but if it's
simply one of
her hobbies...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just know that I would face a repeat of
that scrimmage race if I just
let things be,
however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just know that I would face a repeat of
that scrimmage race if I just
let things be,
however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking that talking to you
could be some good mental
training for me! You
can do that much as my assistant trainer,
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So I was hoping... maybe I could talk with
you to help me build some
mental
fortitude. Would that be okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she may still feel rather uneasy
about opening up about her
personal
interests, to say the least about any
worries she may have.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she may still feel rather uneasy
about opening up about her
personal
interests, to say the least about any
worries she may have.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah... okay. I'll remember that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, thank you. Right, it's probably
best to talk it over if
something's
bothering me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though we have yet to share more than
just a few words, I do feel like
we've
gotten a little better at understanding
each other.
